title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Use of… (CVE-2026-80267)
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 contain a Use of Hard-coded Credentials vulnerability. This flaw allows a low privileged attacker with local access to potentially gain unauthorized access to the system. The vulnerability is rated high severity with a CVSS score of 7.8, indicating significant impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
